continuity: previous_shot null, carry_over []. Regions desk 0.08-0.58 / bin 0.62-0.76 / window 0.55-0.92 do not overlap and match size_in_frame (window box starts at 0.55 to include the rod just left of it).

'five small empty fabric loops hanging from it': a model could read this as curtain rings, cloth loops, hooks or empty hangers, and a reviewer cannot check what 'empty fabric loops' look like. Also the palette 'warm ivory and marble, charcoal' lists 'marble', which a model may paint as a marble texture on wall or floor, and omits the silver, white and pale-wood colours the props use.

fixes: Resolve the rod contradiction. Recommended (simplest, matches the 'simple set, three props' intent): in PR-WINDOW.content change the rod clause to 'just left of the window a single thin straight wooden rod fixed flat to the wall, bare, with nothing hanging from it' and leave must_not 'nothing on the rod' as it is. Update the PR-WINDOW name list in notes if needed.

Alternative if the five loops are needed by later shots: make them clay, not fabric, and say what they are, for example 'five small round clay rings of equal size hanging evenly spaced from the rod, each ring hanging empty'. Then change must_not 'nothing in the bin, nothing on the rod' to 'nothing in the bin, nothing on the rod except its five clay rings', and keep 'no cloth on the set'.

Palette in style: replace 'warm ivory and marble, charcoal' with 'warm ivory, charcoal, silver and white clay, pale wood' (or define marble as a colour only: 'marble-white, no marble texture'), so the model does not paint a marble surface and the prop colours are covered.
